exposure: Timing of meconium discovery (latent 1st stage, active 1st stage, 2nd stage of labor)
Time interval of delivery after discovering MSL
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant ladies with a mean age of 32.3+/-6.4 years, mostly between 20-29 years, admitted to the labor ward with ruptured membranes and gestational ages ranging from 37-42 weeks.
finding: The thickly meconium stained group was significantly associated with a higher cesarean rate, and their delivered babies required more immediate resuscitation.
mod_finding: The thickly meconium stained group was significantly associated with a higher cesarean rate, while the thinly meconium stained group could be considered for vaginal delivery with adequate monitoring.
